entries.content:
# Infantry
| d6 | Ability | Effects |
| 1 | Territorial | Each time this unit makes an attack that targets a unit that is within range of an objective marker, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. |
| 2 | Footsloggers | The move characteristic of models in this unit are increased by 1”. |
| 3 | Fortune Favored | Models in this unit have a 6+ invulnerable save, if this unit already has a Invulnerable save improve that save by 1 to a max of 5+. |
